Skills

Base skills default to 5 as a planning starting point. Edit them to include your class and specialisation before racial and other selected bonuses. Bardcraft is a custom skill.

The world around you

These conditions control situational bonuses. Activated powers are off by default.

Activated powers & spells

Enable a power to preview fixed self effects. Targeted effects and variable magnitudes remain in the ledger. Timed racial effects are treated as activated because their spell type is not recorded.

Make the maths visible

The compendium records effects, but does not define the NEMAS engine settings. Derived values are planning estimates using these explicit assumptions. Adjust them to match your installation.

FatigueSTR + END + AGI + WIL + direct Fatigue modifiers.

Carry capacity5 × Strength. Feather and Burden are shown separately because they modify carried weight.

Attributes & skillsBase + flat bonuses, then percentage changes; minimum zero. Background set/cap rules apply last. Order is a planning assumption where scripts are undocumented.

ResistancesEach resistance and weakness is listed separately with its full source sum, including values over 100%. No global damage-immunity claim is inferred.

Missing valuesUnspecified drains, random changes, unlisted skill groups and other unresolved rules are preserved and flagged; totals can be incomplete for those selections.

Formula references: Bethesda: derived attributes ↗ · OpenMW: independent Reflect / absorption ↗. Engine defaults and NEMAS scripts can differ; use the editable settings above.
